title: Deep Cross-System Simulation
objective: Make Multiversal's domains meaningfully affect one another through explicit governed integrations while preserving every source and target owner domain.

scope.purpose: Make Multiversal's domains meaningfully affect one another through explicit governed integrations.
scope.completion_gate: A declared integration matrix proves deterministic cross-domain effects with traceable owner-domain receipts and no hidden authority shortcuts.

selection_boundaries: MIB-09 remains relationship/reputation authority; SMB-03/ODL/SCL and MIB-11/WCI retain faction, settlement, strategic-consequence and World/location authority.
MIB-13 remains economy/current-price/scarcity/transaction/settlement authority; SMB-07 does not calculate or mutate prices.
SMB-04/D28 remains travel/discovery/Adventure authority, D05 remains role-safe discovery authority, and A9/D24 remains Investigation/Clue/Evidence runtime authority.
Action/Effect/A7/A8 retain damage/combat-result authority; MIB-12 remains repair/crafting-definition authority and APW-03/D26 remains Project/Activity/time authority.
SMB-05/CEL-03 remains base/production projection authority over its owner seams; D17/A8 remains Asset/resource identity/state authority.
Every accepted effect requires a declared integration edge plus already-committed source and target owner receipts/results with an explicit causal link.
No source-owner or target-owner mutation, cross-domain causal formula, inferred permission/action authority or hidden authority shortcut was introduced.
No parallel relationship, faction, settlement, economy, resource, repair/crafting, investigation, base, Adventure, World, Action/Event, Project or authoritative cross-system ledger was created.
No autonomous scheduler, wall-clock progress, provider activation, public/tester distribution, migration or SMB-08 implementation occurred.
